rules.title: Pydantic v2 APIs
rules.text: Use model_validate, model_dump and ConfigDict, not the deprecated v1 APIs.

rules.title: Strict types
rules.text: Use strict field types and constraints (Field, constr, StrictInt) for external data.

rules.title: pydantic-settings
rules.text: Load configuration with pydantic-settings and validate at startup.

rules.title: Immutable models
rules.text: Make value models frozen when they should not change.
